title: Amazon products
description: Two row types share one dataset: product (one product's details from its public page, charged) and status (per ASIN or URL given, free).

domain.description: Marketplace domain suffix, e.g. com, co.uk, de.

url.description: Canonical product URL on that marketplace.

brand.description: Brand from the byline ('Visit the … Store' and 'Brand:' prefixes removed).

price.description: Buybox price as a number. Null when the page shows no buying option (unavailable products, or a marketplace that hides the offer from the caller's location).

price_display.description: The buybox price exactly as printed, e.g. '$54.99'.

currency.description: Currency read from the printed price, falling back to the marketplace's currency. Amazon prices in the caller's location's currency, so this can differ from the marketplace.

list_price.description: The struck-through list price when Amazon shows one.

availability.description: The availability line: 'In Stock', 'Only 3 left in stock', 'Currently unavailable.' and so on, in the marketplace's language.

in_stock.description: true/false from the availability wording, else true when a buybox price exists, else null (unknown).

prime.description: Whether the Prime badge is shown on the offer.

ratings_count.description: How many ratings the product has in total.

image.description: Main image URL (highest resolution the page offers).

images.description: Every gallery image URL, main image first.

features.description: The bullet points under the title.

description.description: The product description block as plain text (up to 2,000 characters), null when Amazon renders none.

breadcrumbs.description: Category path from the breadcrumb bar, top level first. Null on pages without a breadcrumb bar (most amazon.com pages).

category.description: The last breadcrumb, i.e. the product's own category.

details.description: The Product information / Technical details / Product overview tables as {label: value}: dimensions, weight, manufacturer, model number, colour, date first available and whatever else the page lists.

bsr.description: Best Sellers Rank entries [{rank, category}] when the page renders them. Amazon serves the rank to some sessions only, so this is null on many pages.

bsr_top.description: The first Best Sellers Rank number (the top-level category), null when not shown.

date_first_available.description: 'Date First Available' from the details table, as printed.

sold_by.description: The seller line from the buybox, e.g. 'Amazon.com' or 'Amazon Resale and Fulfilled by Amazon'.

variations_count.description: How many variations (colours, sizes, models) the listing carries, null when the page has no variation picker.

5_star_pct.description: Share of ratings that are 5 stars, when the histogram is shown.

status.description: Status rows: ok, filtered, not_found, blocked, limit or error.

target.description: Status rows: the ASIN or URL this job was given.

products.description: Status rows: 1 when the product row was delivered, else 0.

filtered.description: Status rows: 1 when inStockOnly or maxPrice dropped the product, never charged.

duplicates.description: Status rows: 1 when another input already covered this product.

error.description: Status rows: why the product was not delivered, null when it was.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp when the row was fetched.
